title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2611.28997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. translated_title: 引导格式改变医学视觉-语言模型的零样本分类准确率：一项基于结直肠组织病理学的双中心评估
translated_abstract: 背景。托管式医学视觉-语言模型的言语化置信度通常被视为围绕不变预测结果的“包装”。方法。我们保持九分类结直肠组织病理学提示词固定，仅改变所请求的响应格式，并在10,004个验证集图像块和7,180个外部中心PathMNIST图像块上评估MedGemma-27b-it，采用预注册的终点指标、随机化平局处理，并为每个图像块集合重新计算随机下限。结果。与要求输出排序前三名相比，要求输出全部九类概率在验证集上使准确率下降14.8个百分点（-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]），在外部中心下降13.4个百分点（-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]），而随机猜测准确率仅为0.1111。九类提示词独特地禁止了评论、推理和选定答案；在匹配的类别基数和token预算下移除该禁令可恢复+0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134]和+0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]，而改变类别基数……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 仅改变对医学视觉-语言模型的提问格式就能大幅改变其零样本分类准确率——在结直肠组织病理学九分类任务上，要求输出全部九类概率且禁止推理使准确率下降约14个百分点，而在相同类别基数与token预算下允许模型进行推理并给出选定答案可恢复近19个百分点的准确率。
en_tdlr: The elicitation format alone dramatically changes zero-shot classification accuracy of a medical vision-language model: requesting all nine class probabilities while forbidding reasoning cut accuracy by ~14 points on colorectal histopathology, whereas allowing commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer at matched cardinality and token budget recovered ~19 points.
